typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech) variant - focus on readability and precision.

layouts.overall: High-Density Grid (Mode B). Responsive side navigation + top utility bar.
layouts.spacing: Tight spacing for data areas (p-2 to p-4) to maximize viewport real estate. Generous spacing (p-6 to p-8) for outer containers.
layouts.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px border-slate-200. No heavy shadows, use shadow-sm sparingly.
layouts.sidebar: Dark slate (#0F172A) sidebar for contrast against light content area, or pure white with border-r.
layouts.live_metrics_strip: Sticky header strip. Horizontal flex layout. JetBrains Mono for metric values.

components.data_tables: Shadcn UI tables. Compact padding. Right-align numeric columns.
components.forms_inputs: Shadcn UI forms. Sharp corners or rounded-sm. Focus rings must be primary color.
components.charts: Recharts. Use structural grayscale and brand primary. Avoid random color generation.
components.map: Leaflet layer with custom UI buttons overlaid. Polygon draw tools must have active/inactive states.
components.compliance_panel: Grid of rule sets. Use strict Pass/Fail color coding (Success/Danger). Include an icon (Check/X).
components.buttons: Rounded-md. Primary actions get solid brand color. Secondary actions get outline or ghost styles.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' for the main layout. Expose the structural grid with subtle 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas to prevent refraction of text. Use pure solid colors.

motion.data_updates: When a calculation changes, use a subtle background flash (bg-slate-100) or text color transition.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus-visible state (ring-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute.

login_background.description: Architectural blueprints background for login page

empty_project_state.description: Modern apartment building for empty project state

team_collaboration.description: Workers discussing plans on site for roles/sharing view

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn components. Create files with .js/.jsx extensions, not .tsx.
Map module: use react-leaflet, drawing polygons and calculating areas.
Calculations: ensure live updates. Data must be deeply interconnected.
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all inputs, buttons, and important UI sections.
Implement the 2D floor plate as an SVG diagram with clickable or hoverable sections.
Keep standard Vercel/Shadcn look but adapt for high density: tighter paddings, mono fonts for digits.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Ensure all data cells and table headers are properly aligned.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.
